design.justified: dockets/<target>/<slug>/MANIFEST.json is what the pipeline produced, what verify_docket validates and what an operator can read; dockets.manifest_json is a snapshot taken at insert/refresh, so the re-render that repaired the artifact left the row damaged. The artifact serves first; the row is a cache used only when the manifest is absent or unreadable.
design.source_field_why: A silent fallback serving stale metadata is precisely how this defect arose, so every board entry now carries `source` (manifest|store|null) - and, on a fallback, `store_status` plus an `error` naming the missing artifact. Cost is one string; the alternative is an unattributable number.
design.path_safety_helper_reused: safe_docket_slug (segment validation + realpath containment) is applied to EVERY store-row slug candidate, and the candidate must also resolve to an existing directory under the dockets root; file listings keep _contained_realpath / _read_text_capped_checked.
design.store_write_avoided: Read path only. No INSERT/UPDATE, no PRAGMA journal_mode, no store open for writing anywhere in this unit.
